# Continuation Revelation — The River Must Be Proven, Not Merely Painted

The Awtsmoos renews every instant; Awtsmoos.com must renew every claim through evidence.
This continuation does not restart the prior overhaul. It inherits its real artifacts, challenges unverified edges, and closes the remaining graph by runtime proof.

## Observed inheritance

- The prior three-phase plan exists and has been read in full.
- Auto-scroll now imports the production storage key instead of hard-coding an old version.
- The semantic default is 45 WPM, `contemplate`, about 15 px/s.
- A root resolver exists for document scroll and genuinely scrollable `.scroll-view-wrapper` vessels.
- Reader settings, floating actions, discussion, and social core styles were already modularized.
- Historical Heichel archaeology proves route-context includes can fail silently, so browser/runtime proof is mandatory.

## REMAINING_WORK

1. Run targeted auto-scroll tests unchanged first.
2. Discover parent package scripts and actual server command.
3. Derive the recursive active post CSS closure and conflict map.
4. Trace community `/comment-tree` client-to-server behavior.
5. Trace and verify Main Menu ownership plus every registered child view.
6. Verify all Scribe's Lens controls, focus, internal scroll, safe areas, and reduced motion.
7. Sweep Heichel source/runtime across mobile, tablet, desktop, RTL/LTR, and state variants.
8. Inventory and sweep all user-facing Heichelos routes.
9. Inspect the full social import graph and visible subsystems beyond core feed CSS.
10. Audit post/heichel/social/shared CSS for active conflicts and classify dormant debt.
11. Rewrite whole files only where evidence proves a defect; split modules where needed.
12. Run discovered tests, JS syntax checks, and regression scans.
13. Verify 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900 browser classes.
14. Review console and network failures on important routes.
15. Re-read every modified file, audit line counts, and compare plan versus actual.
16. Write implementation readback, browser proof, and final completion-gate notes into the original 0240 directory.

## NEXT_ACTION

Run the inherited auto-scroll unit contracts exactly as the working tree defines them. A pass closes only the unit-test node; browser-measured behavior remains open.
